decisions.reason: The XL tier of the anamnesis app is a cheap extension of an established product for large practices, and with growing industry turnover and slack from a broad installed base there is no shortfall against aspirations to prompt dropping it.

The support service for dental assistants draws on the firm's core service strength and supports retention of its installed base, so its results plausibly meet aspirations and give no reason to shift its resources.

The materials management module is a modular extension of the practice software that fits the paperless, integrated-practice strategy; results are still uncertain after launch, but organisational slack lets the firm carry it.
The KIM secure messaging client is a regulation-driven telematics requirement that dental practices must use, so it is essential to the core offer and far from any aspiration shortfall.
